result.reason: The clause adds the required annual limit, 30 days’ written notice, business-hours restriction, independent confidential auditor, and prohibition on system access. However, it shifts audit costs for any “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than only where an underpayment exceeds 5%, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the original commercial intent, though placing the cost provision before subsection (b) is structurally awkward.
